justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/function/FailableIntUnaryOperator.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/function/FailableTest.java. The class is a small functional interface with only two external outgoing dependencies (java.util.Objects and java.util.function.IntUnaryOperator) plus self-references in its compose/andThen methods. Repository-wide search found no production-code references to it outside its own file; the only incoming uses are 5 test references in FailableTest.java. That does not show the high fan-in/fan-out expected for a hub-like modularization smell.
